scope: Functional bounded-prefix smoke evidence, distinct from the complete AWS experiments.

selection.structured_text: Original bytes compressed with gzip mtime 0; no numeric rewriting.
selection.mixed_metric_bundle: Structured members retained or linked to identical copied content; original manifest retained.
selection.excluded: Presentation HTML/JS/CSS/images/PDF and logs; every omission is enumerated per case.
selection.feature_guard: Only admitted prediction-ledger Parquet; no prepared datasets, model states or raw per-example feature objects.
